label.boardDone: The rings should sit on the board. Mark it again if they don't.
label.tipsHint: Tap where each dart enters the board. Hold to magnify, pinch to zoom.

label.doneSkipped: {count, plural, one {# photo skipped: it's still to label.} other {# photos skipped: they're still to label.}}

settings.title: Settings

settings.about: TU Capture · internal build, not for the App Store

photos.orInLab: Lab has the photos still to label: label them here, or in Lab's review queue.

verify.scoresNote: Amber is short of its bar. Visit right: every dart scored as entered.
verify.worstKey: ○ true tips · ✕ where {name} put them · dashed, the board it found. Board missed first. Open one in Lab's Captures to fix its label.

lab.unset: Set Lab's address in Settings to see its numbers here.

run.going: Still going: it updates here as it runs.

read.title: Check the read
read.hint: Check each dart against the photo, the amber ones most. Tap a dart to fix its score or move its tip.
read.fixHint: Pick its score, or tap the photo where its tip is.
read.blindNote: One visit in {every}, you score it first; {model}'s read shows after, so Lab can tell how often a confirmed read is right.
read.agreed: You and {model} agree. Check the tips, then save.
read.disagreeHint: Look at the photo and say which is right. Either way, Lab counts this visit as a disagreement and it goes to To review there.
read.homeOnHint: You confirm or fix it. 1 in {every} is a blind check.
